kaikki_vikisozluk.e: أُسْتَاذ • (ʔustāḏ) m (plural أَسَاتِذَة (ʔasātiḏa) or أُسْتَاذُون (ʔustāḏūn) or أَسَاتِيذ (ʔasātīḏ), feminine أُسْتَاذَة (ʔustāḏa) or أُسْتَاذ (ʔustāḏ))
g: teacher at a grammar school or similar institution
title of courtesy commonly given to individuals of high education or learning, best translated simply as mister
